Sort Rhino objects into buckets by geometry type

**Panel:** Comma → Data · **Nickname:** `SortByType`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Objects | `rhObj` | Geometry | List |  | Mixed Rhino objects to sort by type |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Points | `pt` | Geometry | List | Point objects |
| Curves | `crv` | Geometry | List | Curve objects |
| Surfaces | `srf` | Geometry | List | Surface objects |
| Breps | `brep` | Geometry | List | Brep objects |
| Meshes | `mesh` | Geometry | List | Mesh objects |
| Text | `txt` | Geometry | List | Text and TextDot objects |
| Hatches | `hatch` | Geometry | List | Hatch objects |
| Lights | `light` | Geometry | List | Light objects |
| Blocks | `block` | Geometry | List | Block instance objects |
| Extrusions | `extr` | Geometry | List | Extrusion objects |
| Other | `other` | Geometry | List | Unrecognized geometry types |
| Type | `type` | Text | List | Type name of each input object |
